# deploy-secrets (facet)

Reads every `defineDeploySecret({ key, description })` call in a plugin's `core/`
(`facet/extract.ts`) — the deploy secrets that plugin needs on a box it is deployed
to. Its one runtime consumer is `apps/deploy/deploy-secrets/approvals`, which collects
it over a composition's closure; see that plugin's `CLAUDE.md`.

Both fields must be static string literals: anything else throws with `file:line`,
because a declaration this reader cannot see is a secret a deploy would never ask the
user to approve.
